title: Arc Fault Detection
description: This project leverages convolutional neural networks to detect arc faults
long_description: This project uses data obtained from an oscilloscope that has been downscaled and transformed into csv files to train a CNN to detect arc faults. The data gathered included data from various household appliances as well as simulated conditions.
